title: Concurrent edit churn policy
description: One schema-first policy for every step that reads inputs other processes may edit at the same time. A step reads its inputs as a snapshot; when a concurrent edit is detected, the layer that owns the snapshot takes a new one and runs the step again, a bounded number of times with a growing pause, and says so in the declared languages. Only an edit that persists through every attempt of the widest layer fails, naming the path.

primaryFirstAggregates: Original physical body, drain and cleanup settlement failed

en.descriptor: its open descriptor no longer matched its path
en.generation: the shared generation it belongs to moved

de.descriptor: der offene Deskriptor passte nicht mehr zum Pfad
de.generation: die geteilte Generation, zu der sie gehört, wechselte

en.retry: Another process edited {path} while it was read ({reason}). Taking a new snapshot, attempt {attempt} of {maximum}, in {delay} ms.
en.exhausted: {path} kept changing in all {maximum} attempts ({reason}): another process edits it continuously. Run the command again once the edits have stopped.

de.retry: Ein anderer Prozess änderte {path} während des Lesens ({reason}). Neuer Schnappschuss, Versuch {attempt} von {maximum}, in {delay} ms.
de.exhausted: {path} änderte sich in allen {maximum} Versuchen ({reason}): ein anderer Prozess bearbeitet es laufend. Den Befehl erneut ausführen, sobald die Änderungen aufgehört haben.
